row.name: Handprints Child Care 15 LLC DBA Handprints Academy

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: A non-routine situation (e.g., child exiting the classroom and front door of the facility, entering the parking lot and briefly leaving the premises) which placed a child at risk was not recorded on an incident report form as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There was sufficient evidence obtained from a DFPS investigation to conclude that operation staff failed to provide the level of supervision/proximity necessary to ensure a child?s safety as witnesses confirmed that a child was able to exit the classroom and front door of the building, resulting in the child gaining access to the parking lot and briefly leaving the premises prior to being apprehended by operation staff.  The child was uninjured as a result of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Operation staff failed to report a non-routine situation which placed a child at risk (e.g., child exiting the classroom and front door of the facility, entering the parking lot and briefly leaving the premises) to CCR as required.  The child was uninjured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: There was evidence that corporal punishment was utilized during a disciplinary incident at the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with an ineligible background check was allowed to be present with children while her background check results were pending.  The caregiver is no longer employed at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: A 17-year-old was allowed to be routinely present in a volunteer role without having an initial background check submitted as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A Review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 22, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two children were left on the playground unsupervised for approximately two minutes.  The caregiver responsible was terminated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: There was a diaper changing mat that had two tears in the mat.    The Director corrected this at the time of the inspection by replacing the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There was one infant feeding instruction sheet that was not signed by the parent.    The Director is going to correct this by getting the feeding instructions signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence showing caregivers are not prompt with diaper changing due to caregivers and parents regularly finding children with soiled diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence to support caregivers have been heard on multiple occasions yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence to support a caregiver has used corporal punishment on her own child on the premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence to support children have been left in a classroom or on the playground more that once without supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence to suggest there were times the operation has been out of ratio due to the caregiver leaving the room unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: Based on the information gathered there is enough evidence that teachers have been using inappropriate discipline with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: There is not enough evidence to support the allegations.    There is enough evidence to support that caregivers were not taking children who had bathroom accidents to the bathroom in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Seven out of twenty children's records were missing health statements.    The Director is going to correct this by getting the health statments.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: The caregviers were not having the parents sign their children in and out.  The caregivers were doing this and putting mom, dad, grandma, or grandpa for children who were not even picked up by those people.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: The caregivers were not recording the identity of people who were picking up children who the caregiver did not know.  They were also not verifying if the person was on the child's admission form as an authorized person to pick up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: The operation did not have the proper plan in place for the guidelines for the release of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan: Caregivers have not been trained on the proper techniques for the release of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan (26 TAC §746.4103(c))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: A child's napping on a nap mat was blocking an exit.  A photo was taken of this.    The Caregiver corrected this at the time of the inspection by moving the child to a different area of the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: All play areas on the playground need the required amount of loose fill. Photos were taken of this.    The Director is working on getting the loose fill and will have the caregivers up supervision until the loose fill is installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The substitutions for what the children ate for lunch and breakfast was not put on the menu.  A photo was taken of the menu and their lunch.    The Director corrected this at the time of the inspection by writing down the substitutions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The operation had dead roaches on the floors after an extermination was done and the floors were not cleaned properly. There were also dead roaches found under a diaper changing mat due to not properly cleaning and sanitation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
